description: Waterway — Catchment — Basin areas is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset published by Brisbane City Council contains South East Queensland waterway basin areas. It covers the area from approximately Noosa to the north, Toowoomba to the west and the New South Wales state border to the south. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are arcgis, environment, water, waterway, catchment, basin. The portal shows 14 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
